name: vdl.np-downloader.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 6 internal links lead to an error.
lesson: Check your own links after each release, and fix or redirect every one that answers 404.
summary: vdl.np-downloader.com scores 67 out of 100 (D). 3 checks fail now, 29 are at risk, and 25 pass. Fix first: 6 internal links lead to an error.

fix.title: 6 internal links lead to an error
fix.evidence: /nollywood-movies/ answered 404, linked from /, /yoruba-movies/ and 4 more. /yoruba-movies/ answered 404, linked from /, /nollywood-movies/ and 4 more. /biography/ answered 404, linked from /, /nollywood-movies/ and 4 more. /tag/premium/ answered 404, linked…
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (1 request), and cookies __cf_bm on grop.net, GL_UI4 on wq.idlesliver.com, _ga_0HHS44JF6D, _ga, AU on ftd.agency, rauid on uidsync.net.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: 2 resources fail to load
fix.fix: Fix or remove the broken references.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4 appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The largest element paints in 0.3 s
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
